title: 3rd string: G and A
summary: The last two notes of the chapter.

steps.title: G and A
text: The open 3rd string is **G**, on the second line. The space above it is **A**, at the 2nd fret. Use your 2nd finger.
The next note up is one you know already: the open 2nd string, **B**.

steps.title: The whole set
text: That makes eight notes, from the open 3rd string up to the 3rd fret of the 1st string: **G A B C D E F G**.
Note names use the letters A to G, then start again.

steps.title: Up and back
text: Just the 3rd string and the open 2nd. Second finger for A.

steps.title: All eight notes
text: Up through all eight notes and back down again. Go slowly enough that you never have to stop.
